subject: Fraud & Scams
title: What Makes a Con Work
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Makes a Con Work.

hook.text: Every con follows the same formula: find a mark, earn trust, then exploit it.

buildup.text: Con artists call their victims 'marks' — targets chosen for specific vulnerabilities.

discovery.text: The core of every con is manufactured trust. Without it, no scam can succeed.

twist.text: Marks rarely suspect fraud because the con mirrors legitimate interactions they already trust.

climax.text: Understanding the anatomy of a con is the single best defense against becoming a victim.

punchline.text: Cons don't break rules. They exploit trust.

quiz.question: What is the core ingredient of every con?
